dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: #When will you be free, {NICKNAME}? I want to hear more stories from you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rana...

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: Rana would tell us stories every time she returns from the forest. But I still prefer stories of the sea...

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: I swear I'll become a great captain!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Aranara...

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: #No... I won't say anything... We agreed to keep it a secret, even from {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the tale of the giant sea serpent...

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: #Yes, the giant sea serpent in {NICKNAME}'s story sounds amazing. But there's nothing more to it now that it's already been taken down.

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: I wonder if there are other giant sea serpents... If so, that'll be the moment when Captain Kavus makes his entrance!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: So you say...

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: Why isn't Rana back yet? She's been gone for so long...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rana...

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: Rana would tell us stories every time she returns from the forest. But I still prefer stories of the sea...

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: I swear I'll become a great captain!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the tale of the giant sea serpent...

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: #Yes, the giant sea serpent in {NICKNAME}'s story sounds amazing. But there's nothing more to it now that it's already been taken down.

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: I wonder if there are other giant sea serpents... If so, that'll be the moment when Captain Kavus makes his entrance!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: Okay, let's play later!

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: Will Rana come back this time?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rana...

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: Rana said she was leaving for a trip and would be away for a very long time, much longer than before...

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: But since I'm older than Sudabeh and Iotham, I'll take care of them for her!

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: Let's play with Rana once she gets back!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Aranara...

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: Rana has gone traveling, and I haven't seen my friends in the forest for a long time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: #See you, {NICKNAME}, please visit Vimara Village often!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Take good care of Sudabeh and Iotham.

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: I will. I'm gonna be a good big brother, and I'll never leave them behind! Otherwise, Rana will criticize me.

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: #There will come a day when I become Captain Kavus, free as a seagull. To make it come true, I've been fishing with Dad. These are the fish I caught, I want to give them to you, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: #Um... By the way, Sudabeh said recently she's been learning to cook on her own so that she can be a big girl soon. So if you happen to eat something suspicious she made... well... please don't be hard on her, {NICKNAME}!
